summary: Reverted leaked tool-specific heuristics from ANSWER prompt to comply with constitution.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the hard-coded instruction to distrust general-purpose model negatives when specialized tools fail eliminates task-specific leakage and grader gaming, restoring a generic prompt that relies on the agent's inherent reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific biases.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous edit introduced specific knowledge about tool architecture ('specialized diagnostic tool', 'general-purpose model') which violates the constitution. Reverting to the base prompt is the only way to remove this leakage while maintaining a functional harness.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active during final answer generation.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, the agent will no longer receive biased instructions to distrust negative findings, but will still be instructed to verify against original pixels. (preservative) Removes the specific bias that could cause false positives in other tasks. (transfer) Generalizes to any task without assuming specific tool hierarchies.
edits.regression_risk: Low; reverts to a safer, more general prompt that was previously accepted before the leaked edit.
edits.mechanism: Removing the hard-coded instruction to distrust general-purpose model negatives when specialized tools fail eliminates task-specific leakage and grader gaming, restoring a generic prompt that relies on the agent's inherent reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific biases.
